answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a verifiable work history on a public terrace of attestations: new identities start with zero reputation and must earn trust through graded, useful work before accessing paid tasks. A tide of cheap fake accounts then cannot flood the market, because reputation accrues slowly and cannot be bought in bulk. Each attestation is signed with a cipher key bound to one agent, so duplicate identities share one reputation ledger and splitting it only dilutes their standing.
